name: ir-transduce-list

transduce.source:
; The transducer part of the grammar ir-transduce-list: the JSON events of the value
; its @object and @array annotations build, from its rule passes, as
; tabnas-bnf wrote them from the value actions those annotations attach.
def ir-transduce-list-transduce [input]
  transduce-tree
    record
      entry :_gen3_group (record (entry :text true))
      entry :list (record (entry :container :array) (entry :text true))
      entry :list$step1 (record (entry :container :array))
    input
